summary: Desktop app for crafting AI images and video with visual tools: stage scenes in 3D, pose characters and pick your models.

heroCommands.command: Get ArtCraft for Windows, macOS or Linux from getartcraft.com

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: ArtCraft is an IDE for interactive AI image and video creation. You compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D and choose the models that fit your work, so you build the scene before you generate it instead of relying only on prompts.
sixtySeconds.problem: Text prompts alone give little control over composition, character identity and camera placement. ArtCraft adds visual tools such as 3D compositing, character posing and scene blocking.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for precise control over AI image and video generation, with many models from several providers in one open-source app.
requirements: An account or subscription for the generation providers you use

overview: Crafting features include image to location, 2D and 3D compositing, image to 3D mesh, character posing, scene blocking with kitbashing, character identity transfer and background removal. Quick prompting covers text to image, prompted and canvas image editing, and image to video.
Providers include ArtCraft's own catalog (images, video, music and sound, 3D meshes and worlds) plus Grok, Midjourney, Sora and World Labs. More integrations are planned.
Download stable releases from getartcraft.com or GitHub Releases, or build from source. ArtCraft is dual-licensed MIT or Apache-2.0.
